events.verdict: Strus (CLE) momentarily applies his left arm to Anunoby's (NYK) arm before immediately removing his arm as Anunoby begins his upward shooting motion.
Anunoby (NYK) legally contests Strus' (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) brings his arms towards Anunoby's (NYK) path as he crosses in front of him, and the body contact during the layup attempt is marginal.
Strus (CLE) jumps slightly forward towards Anunoby (NYK) and the contact prior to the shot being blocked is marginal.
Strus (CLE) makes contact with the ball prior to it coming into contact with the backboard during Anunoby's (NYK) layup attempt.
Garland (CLE) legally contests Hart's (NYK) layup attempt at the basket.
Wade (CLE) and Hart (NYK) extend their arms up towards the ball in pursuit of the loose ball, and the contact during the rebound is marginal.
Hart (NYK) initiates contact with Wade's (CLE) arm/wrist that causes him to lose control of the rebound.
Garland's (CLE) right hand does not come underneath the ball as he legally brings the ball over to his left side during his drive into the frontcourt.
Garland (CLE) establishes the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Strus' (CLE) arms come out slightly as he establishes himself in Bridges' (NYK) and the ensuing contact during the pick is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) brings his left hand forward towards the ball, and the contact with Garland's (CLE) upper body during his drive is marginal.

Robinson (NYK) is drifting slightly to his left as he absorbs the marginal contact from Garland (CLE) during the driving shot attempt. Robinson's body rotates slightly as a natural reaction to absorbing the contact with Garland in the air.
Strus (CLE) moves alongside Brunson's (NYK) path with his right arm in a legal vertical position, and he absorbs the contact from Brunson during the shot attempt.
Brunson (NYK) brings his right arm to Strus' (CLE) right leg before immediately removing his arm, and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Robinson (NYK) brings his left arm forward and initiates contact with Strus' (CLE) arm that affects his SQBR.
Garland (CLE) is retreating in Anunoby's (NYK) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during his driving shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) and Strus (CLE) come together in the air as they pursue the rebound, and the contact that occurs as Strus gains possession is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) commits a take foul on Mobley (CLE).
Hart (NYK) is already in Okoro's (CLE) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
